summary: Review real user journeys and turn observed usability issues into prioritized fixes.
intents: review the usability of our onboarding flow
why are users dropping off at checkout
do a heuristic evaluation of this app
find confusing parts of the settings page
prioritize UX fixes for the next sprint
prerequisites: a working interface, screenshots, prototype, or user-journey description
target users and key tasks; user testing or analytics recommended
verify: Each issue cites the journey step, evidence and severity
Fixes are prioritized by user impact and effort
Findings from heuristics are separated from observed user behaviour
